'''Jurio''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="Codex" /> in the [[Jurio system/Legends|Jurio system]], a part of the [[Corva sector/Legends|Corva sector]]<ref name="Companion" /> in the [[New Territories/Legends|New Territories]] portion of<ref name="New Territories" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="Companion" /> It was [[Homeworld/Legends|home]] to the winged creature known as the [[Juriod fang-flier]].<ref name="Platt" /><ref name="Planetnamia" />

Sometime between [[3681 BBY]]<ref name="Encyclopedia">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]''</ref> and [[3669 BBY]],<ref name="Date">Act I of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' takes place in [[3643 BBY]] per the reasoning [[Template:TOR dates/1|here]]. ''The Old Republic''{{'s}} Codex entry "Intelligence Profile: Vector Hyllus" establishes [[Vector Hyllus]] to be 26 [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of age, and the Codex entry is acquired during Act I, which means Hyllus was [[Reproduction/Legends|born]] in [[3669 BBY]].</ref> Jurio was conquered by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] in the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of their [[Great Galactic War|invasion]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Jurio was granted Imperial governance, a fact which allowed [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Adronik Hyllus]] of the [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|Imperial Military]] to [[Marriage/Legends|marry]] a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Vector Hyllus's mother|woman]] native to Jurio, and the two had a [[Reproduction/Legends|son]] that they named [[Vector Hyllus|Vector]] on Jurio<ref name="Codex" /> in 3669 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]].<ref name="Date" />

The planet remained under Imperial control for many years afterward, and during his career, the intelligence operative [[Rane Kovach]] carried out an assignment on Jurio at the request of [[Theron Shan]] of the [[Republic Strategic Information Service]]; Kovach was tasked with infiltrating dissident groups and fomenting revolution against the Sith Empire while minimizing casualties.<ref name="Kovach">{{TORcite|type=codex|exp=shadow|SIS Asset Brief: Agent Rane Kovach}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Jurio was first mentioned in the Codex entry for Vector Hyllus in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]].<ref name="Codex" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' had previously placed the Jurio [[Star system/Legends|star system]], and therefore the planet itself, in grid square P-4.<ref name="Atlas" />
